description: This file defines a composable function for displaying an asynchronously loaded image with a shimmer effect placeholder in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes a custom Modifier extension for shimmer animation and a preview function.

methods.name: AsyncShimmerImage
methods.description: Composable function that displays an image with a shimmer loading placeholder and error handling.

methods.name: Preview
methods.description: Preview composable for the shimmer image with a default placeholder.

methods.name: Modifier.shimmer
methods.description: Extension function that adds a shimmer animation effect to a Modifier.
